job.job_title: AIML Engineer With GenAI, Python, AWS
job.job_description:
Job Description: Senior Engineer GenAI / Machine Learning / Python / AWS

Experience: 5–7 Years
Location: [Add Location / Remote / Hybrid]

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Engineer with strong expertise in Generative AI (GenAI), Machine Learning, Python, and AWS. The ideal candidate will design, build, and deploy scalable AI/ML solutions, including Generative AI applications leveraging LLMs, while ensuring performance, reliability, and production readiness.

Key Responsibilities

1. GenAI & ML Model Development

Design and develop machine learning and Generative AI solutions for real-world business problems.
Build applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT, Llama, etc.
Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
Fine-tune or adapt pre-trained models where applicable.

2. Application Development (Python)

Develop robust backend services and pipelines using Python.
Work with libraries and frameworks such as:
TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn
LangChain, LlamaIndex (preferred)
Build APIs to expose ML/GenAI capabilities.

3. Cloud & AWS Implementation

Design and deploy ML/AI solutions on AWS cloud platform.
Work with services such as:
SageMaker
Lambda
S3, EC2, RDS
API Gateway
Bedrock (for GenAI) – preferred
Ensure scalability, monitoring, and cost optimization of AI workloads.

4. Data Engineering & Processing

Work with structured and unstructured data.
Build data pipelines, preprocessing, and feature engineering workflows.
Ensure high-quality datasets for model training and validation.

5. Model Deployment & MLOps

Deploy models into production using MLOps practices.
Implement CI/CD for ML pipelines.
Monitor model performance, drift, and retraining needs.
Use tools like Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow (good to have).

6. System Design & Integration

Design scalable AI/ML architectures integrated with enterprise systems.
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to embed AI capabilities.
Ensure security, compliance, and responsible AI practices.

7. Research & Innovation

Stay updated with the latest advancements in GenAI and ML.
Evaluate new tools, models, and frameworks.
Drive innovation and proof-of-concepts (POCs).

Required Skills

Core Technical Skills

Strong experience in:
Python programming
Machine Learning algorithms and concepts
Generative AI / LLM-based applications
Hands-on experience with:
PyTorch / TensorFlow / Scikit-learn
LangChain / LLM orchestration frameworks
Experience in building and deploying REST APIs.

Cloud & DevOps

Strong experience with AWS services for ML and application deployment.
Knowledge of:
CI/CD tools
Containerization (Docker)
Orchestration (Kubernetes – plus)

Data Skills

Experience with:
Data preprocessing and feature engineering
SQL / NoSQL databases
Handling large-scale datasets

Preferred Skills

Experience with:
RAG architectures and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, OpenSearch)
Prompt engineering and prompt optimization
Fine-tuning LLMs
Knowledge of:
Responsible AI, AI governance
Model explainability tools

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
Ability to work independently and lead technical initiatives.
Innovative thinking and curiosity for emerging technologies.

Educational Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or related field.

Nice to Have

Certifications in:
AWS (ML Specialty / Solutions Architect)
Experience in domains like:
Healthcare, Finance, Retail analytics

Summary

This role is ideal for professionals passionate about building next-generation AI applications using Generative AI and Machine Learning, with strong foundations in Python and cloud technologies (AWS). You will play a critical role in driving AI innovation and delivering scalable intelligent solutions.
